about_the_game:
Jump into Mine Spiders, a relentless nightmare buried beneath the desert.

The mission was simple: locate the missing team and restore contact. But the deeper you go, the clearer it becomes that this place is far from abandoned.


Infested with towering, flesh-eating spiders that move faster than your light can catch, crawling across ceilings, walls, and out of every shadow. With each step forward, the mine closes in shrinking corridors, flickering flares, and the echo of something moving just around the corner.

Descend deeper into the mine exploring and shooting your way through 8 intense levels, each taking you deeper into the mine's twisted depths. From collapsing tunnels to web-covered chambers, every level ramps up the chaos with more enemies, tighter spaces, and escalating horror.

Crafted by solo-dev nokturnal artist from Detroit, Michigan. Mine Spiders pushes the limits of fast-paced high intensity horror combat, 360-degree threat awareness, and bodycam-style photorealism—delivering a uniquely raw high contrast experience for the genre.

This isn’t survival. This is extermination.

Key Features: 

Terrifying Enemies: Battle massive, flesh-eating spiders that swarm from walls, ceilings, and tunnels. They're fast, aggressive, and everywhere. 

Tactical FPS Combat: Fight your way through claustrophobic tunnels with brutal gunplay, dynamic lighting, and high-impact visuals that don’t hold back. 

Bodycam Horror Experience: Feel the chaos through a raw, unfiltered bodycam perspective that puts you right in the middle of the nightmare. 

High-Intensity Gunplay: Shoot, jump, and blast your way through waves of enemies in tight underground spaces with bodycam-style first-person combat. 

Immersive Environments: Explore a dark, abandoned mine brought to life with gritty visuals, creepy atmosphere, and web-covered tunnels. 

Weapon Variety: Locate new weapons as you progress, each with its own firepower to help you wipe out the spider horde. Relentless Action: No puzzles just pure forward momentum as you fight your way deeper and try to survive what’s below.

Armed with heavy firepower and no backup, you’ll blast through swarms of aggressive enemies in an unbroken descent through darkness. 

Just you, your gun, and the horrors waiting below.

Originally developed as a brutal vision of first-person terror, Mine Spiders combines the raw intensity of tactical combat with an immersive bodycam horror perspective, delivering a new kind of nightmare.

content_descriptors.notes:
The developers describe the content like this:
Mine Spiders is a first-person horror shooter that contains intense violence, graphic depictions of large flesh-eating spiders, and frequent scenes of shooting and killing monstrous enemies. The game features fast-paced combat and disturbing imagery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD™ Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3800X, Intel Core i7-10700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: MD Radeon RX 6600 XT (8 GB), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Explore the depths of a dark, abandoned mine in this ultra-realistic High-Intensity FPS horror game. Blast through flesh-eating spiders crawling everywhere. Challenge your 360-threat awareness and shoot through swarms to escape this nightmare. No turning back. How long can you survive in the dark?
